milestone: S2 realized stream-rate ceiling of the client path
objective: Measure what fraction of the accepted R5 ceiling our WSL -> HTTP -> Host -> RFCOMM path actually realizes, at the 150 ms Host floor, with webcam-representative full-palette payloads and per-frame dispatch-to-ACK timing. R1-R5 measured the DEVICE; this measures OUR OVERHEAD, which is the unknown that a live webcam pipeline has to be designed against.

target.pairing_precheck: authenticated exact target required before any socket is created

transport.connection_shape: one persistent RFCOMM connection; one ACK per frame; strictly synchronous; no retry, reconnect or pipelining
transport.one_controller_rule: the persistent MCP product supervisor must be stopped for the full 60 s and restarted immediately afterward; the Android Divoom app must stay disconnected; OpenTivoo runtime/task/port 8779 remain untouched
transport.host_change: none; the Host build and its 150 ms floor are unchanged at fb750078...

build.installed_identity_note: Verified in-session 2026-09-09: repository Release build and deployed DLL byte-identical. This trial changes WSL Python only.

session.shape: one connection; the 60-frame clip loops at the 150 ms Host floor for 60 s; every consecutive frame differs so nothing is held as unchanged; then close
session.semantic_evidence: No new device command semantics and no new rate territory: R4 sustained 131 ms/frame and R5 reached 54.2 ms/frame on this unit at this payload size. 150 ms is slower than both. Only the measurement is new.

stream.source_description: deterministic generated near-full-palette rotating field, 250 colours and 1039 application bytes per frame, matching the R4/R5 measured payload and the worst case a 16x16 webcam frame can reach; generated offline by scripts/make_stream_demo_frames.py fullcolour

budgets.derivation: 60 s at 150 ms admits 401 frame starts, and the 60-frame clip loops so the clock bounds the count. 401 x 3 packets; worst-case 1039 application bytes per frame (250-colour image packet plus both stock preambles) gives 416639 bytes. Payload matches the accepted R4/R5 ladder, which sent 1048 application bytes per frame.

already_measured_offline.note: measured this session with no device I/O; together ~2.5 ms, so anything beyond that is wire time

measurement_plan.question_answered: whether our path can hold the 150 ms floor with zero dropped steps, and how much of each 150 ms window is wire time -- which sets the target for any future Host-floor lift
measurement_plan.explicitly_not_a_rate_ladder_rerun: R1-R5 are complete and are not repeated. This runs SLOWER than both R4 and R5 and adds instrumentation only.

expected_observations.transport: one connection, up to 401 ACKed frames, 1203 packets, 416639 application bytes, clean lifetime_expired
expected_observations.physical: a continuously shifting full-colour field for 60 s with no visible stall, tear or freeze; individual frames are not separately identifiable by eye at 6.67 fps and are not expected to be
expected_observations.interpretation: Establishes the realized ceiling of the CURRENT client path at the CURRENT Host floor. It does not establish a new device ceiling and does not authorize a faster one.

persistence_analysis.product_policy_effect: none; policy and frozen code untouched

stop_immediately_on: unexpected target identity or pairing precheck failure
any unsolicited state report on the link (canvas is no longer ours)
any inbound bytes that do not parse as exactly one valid wrapped report
any ACK that is not our wrapped 0x44 shape with a single payload byte
any send that does not complete in full
the worker falling silent for longer than the Host grace period
stop_policy.on_ambiguous_outcome: stop sending, close the link, record completed/unknown bytes and last known display state; never resend, reconnect or reclaim
stop_policy.recovery: restart the already-authorized persistent product service after the stream returns

authority.grant_scope_requested: ONE execution only of OPENDITOO-S2-STREAM-RATE-001: stop the persistent MCP product supervisor, stream the frozen 60-frame near-full-palette field (frame_set_sha256 c8200bb34ddd65fc32238c894c7bd215e1118a576528dafdda4d7a6a7b66f280) on loop to exact Ditoo 11:75:58:CE:DE:C7 through the existing typed /v1/session/* transaction at the 150 ms Host floor for a 60 s bounded lifetime (401 frames, 1203 packets, 416639 application bytes, one connection, one ACK per frame), capturing per-frame dispatch-to-ACK timing, then restart the persistent product supervisor; no retry, reconnect, reclaim, pipelining, raw send, target override, firmware or persistent write, and no change to the Windows Host build.

explicitly_out_of_scope: lowering the Windows Host 150 ms floor (needs a Host rebuild and a Runtime 003 product policy)
any rate above the accepted R5 ceiling
raw send, target selection or command enumeration
firmware, gallery or any persistent write
any target other than the exact unit
